segments.text: You are walking through the office area and notice a colleague wearing a laboratory coat.
segments.zh: 你正走过办公区，注意到一位同事穿着实验服。

segments.text: You are concerned about the potential for exposure and if this is approved behavior
segments.zh: 你担心这可能造成暴露，也不确定这种行为在非实验区域

segments.text: What safety resources are available to you to discuss personal protective equipment
segments.zh: 有哪些安全资源可以让你讨论个人防护装备
以及其他与安全相关的问题？
